FEAT-ALL.description: Complete modern UI redesign of all project module pages with dramatically different layouts
FEAT-ALL.findings: Build passes cleanly (tsc -b && vite build). All 9 pages were redesigned with dramatic layout changes: split-pane shell with sidebar navigation, gradient mesh hero sections, glassmorphism cards, multi-step wizards, bento grid dashboards, view toggles. Three legacy pages (AlertDeliveryLogsPage, DeadLetterQueuePage, RemoteConfigPage) were fully rewritten from old observe/FillPage patterns to modern pulse design system primitives. AlertRouteWizardPage was also modernized.

FEAT-REDESIGN-BATCH2.description: Redesign all 12 remaining project module pages with dramatic modern UI layouts
FEAT-REDESIGN-BATCH2.findings: Build passes cleanly (tsc -b && vite build). All 12 pages redesigned with: glassmorphism cards (bg-[var(--bg1)]/70 backdrop-blur-sm), colored left accent borders, hover lift effects (-translate-y-0.5), gradient fills on charts, SVG gradient defs, sticky floating toolbar, vertical timeline with connector lines, large circular gauge, monogram avatars, severity-colored borders, flow-card visualization, pulse animations for status, date-grouped items with sticky headers, card-based layouts replacing tables where appropriate.
